text:
Alex: main pipeline went red right after merge of #1345 — smoke/gpu timed out, anyone around?
CI Bot: build 5188887766 failed on branch main. Failed tests: smoke/gpu::test_inference_timeout (timeout after 120s). Logs: https://ci.internal/5188887766 
Maria: grabbing logs now, one sec
Maria: looks like GPU allocator OOM-ish errors right before the timeout:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when trying to allocate 256MB
File "runtime/allocator.cpp", line 412, in allocate
  at runtime::kv_cache::evict_if_needed()
```
Devon: I merged #1345 earlier — small allocator tweak. I didn't see this locally. cc @Sneha
Sneha: hmm that change touched the eviction heuristics, could increase fragmentation under parallel smoke workloads.
Devon: can someone kick a rerun while I look? /rerun would be ideal
Alex: @Devon go ahead, if rerun fails we'll plan a bisect or revert depending on impact
Devon: okay triggering rerun now: `/rerun 5188887766`
CI Bot: Rerun triggered by Devon. New job: 5188887820 (queued)
Maria: I'll tail the new run and grab the exact failing test output if it reappears
CI Bot: Rerun 5188887820 completed — smoke/gpu flaky: test_inference_timeout timed out again (1/3 flaky)
Devon: ugh, reproduces on CI consistently. I'm going to try a quick reproduce on a dev GPU instance. If I can reproduce locally I'll push a fix; otherwise we should consider reverting to restore main.
Sneha: I'll start an automated bisect across the last 8 merges to narrow suspects. If bisect pins to #1345 that argues for revert.
CI Bot: Bisect job started for range HEAD~8..HEAD. This may take ~30m.
Maria: FYI the console shows memory spike ~1.9GB just before eviction call — seems correlated
CI Bot: Bisect result: suspect commit is PR #1345 (author Devon) — reproduces on bisect runner.
Alex: Thanks. Given bisect points to #1345 and it breaks smoke/gpu, please open a revert PR for immediate unblock. Devon, can you file revert and a follow-up fix?
Devon: filing revert now: created PR #1350 (revert of #1345), adding changelog and note to investigate allocator heuristics. Marking for fastmerge.
Sneha: I'll keep bisect artifacts and run a focused reproducer to help the fix.
Maria: great, thanks everyone. Watching health dash and will confirm when main turns green. :thumbsup:
